name: ProtectSheet
label: Protect Sheet (HTTP)
description: Protects an Excel worksheet with an optional password.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel file in the drive (e.g., 'Reports/ProtectedSheet.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to protect (e.g., 'Financials').

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password (Optional)
fields.description: An optional password to protect the sheet. If provided, users will need it to unprotect the sheet. Leave blank for password-less protection.
